source.test: A. prog/rp-upper-meso: every literal the evaluator read shows its number in the description

ret: 2 training days (upperA and upperB) holding 6 exercises, over block weeks accumulation ×4, deload, once.
Block weeks: accumulation, accumulation, accumulation, accumulation, deload, once. If you miss a session the plan waits: the next session is still the one you missed. Loads on a 2 kg grid.
Rotation: Each training week: Day upperA, then Day upperB.
Attendance (from the rotation): Train at least 2 times in each 7-day window (from your start day). If you don't train for 21 days, attendance stops counting until your next session.
Reads your soreness check-in (checked in before the session; ignored once older than a day); your pump rating (rated after the session); your joint-pain rating (rated after the session).
In deload block weeks: deload each session: 90% of the load, 100% of any timed work, 50% of the sets, at least 4 in reserve, and no intensifier.
Always: any change to your set counts is proposed for your OK instead of applied.
flatDb: 2 sets of Flat DB Press for 8 reps to 12 reps plus any sets the muscle plan adds, reps in reserve stepping 3→0 across the block; add 2 kg once every set reaches 12 reps.
inclineDb: 2 sets of Incline DB Press for 8 reps to 12 reps plus any sets the muscle plan adds, reps in reserve stepping 3→0 across the block; add 2 kg once every set reaches 12 reps.
cableFlyA: 1 set of Cable Fly for 12 reps to 20 reps plus any sets the muscle plan adds, reps in reserve stepping 3→0 across the block; add 2.5 kg once every set reaches 20 reps.
cableFlyB: 1 set of Cable Fly for 12 reps to 20 reps plus any sets the muscle plan adds, reps in reserve stepping 3→0 across the block; add 2.5 kg once every set reaches 20 reps.
row: 3 sets of Chest-Supported Row for 8 reps to 12 reps plus any sets the muscle plan adds, reps in reserve stepping 3→0 across the block; add 2.5 kg once every set reaches 12 reps.
pulldown: 3 sets of Lat Pulldown for 10 reps to 15 reps plus any sets the muscle plan adds, reps in reserve stepping 3→0 across the block; add 2.5 kg once every set reaches 15 reps.

At the end of each block week (muscle plan): Next week's target is for each muscle, your weekly set target for that muscle (0 sets if unknown) plus the sets earned given your soreness check-in for that muscle and your pump rating for that muscle, capped at (by that muscle: chest → 22 sets; back → 25 sets; any other → 0 sets). The reallocation is starting from your weekly extra sets, for each muscle in turn: hand out the sets still to place [(next week's target for the muscle (0 sets if unknown) minus the sets the muscle got in the week just ended, accumulation weeks only), never below 0 sets], one set at a time and at most 8 in all, each to whichever of the exercises that train the muscle directly ranks highest by the stimulus-to-fatigue score from your pump rating for the muscle and your joint-pain rating for that exercise (0 if either is unrated), at most 4 sets extra per exercise. Then:
    - if the reallocation is unknown: Leave everything as is.
    - otherwise: Set weekly set target to next week's target; set weekly extra sets to the reallocation.

Starts with working weight = nothing; written by session, owner.

Plan: Flat DB Press: 2 sets plus the weekly extra sets the program keeps for this exercise (0 sets if unknown) of 8 reps to 12 reps at your working weight with 3/2/1/0 in reserve (slashed values step by training week, then holding the last).

After each session: Set working weight to whichever is known first: (1) (if every working set reached the top of its range: your working weight plus 2 kg; if a working set fell short: your working weight; if nothing fell short but something went unlogged: your working weight); (2) the best load you logged on “work”.
